description: Add a row of up to 6 Instagram posts or reels and TikTok videos, in the order given, with an optional title such as "Latest on Instagram". Layouts: carousel (a swipeable row, the default), grid (3 columns of thumbnails, like a profile; each opens the post) or single (the first post, big). Use full links (instagram.com/p/…, instagram.com/reel/…, tiktok.com/@name/video/…). The row doesn't update by itself: replace the links with update_block urls.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

urls.description: Instagram post or reel links and TikTok video links.

name: add_posts
title: Add a row of posts
